## GPS Models

```{r Checking poisson for over or underdispersion}

overdisp_fun <- function(model) {
  rdf <- df.residual(model)
  rp <- residuals(model, type = "pearson")
  chisq <- sum(rp^2)
  ratio <- chisq/rdf
  # Two-sided: test whichever tail the ratio falls in
  if (ratio < 1) {
    p <- pchisq(chisq, df = rdf, lower.tail = TRUE)
    direction <- "underdispersion"
  } else {
    p <- pchisq(chisq, df = rdf, lower.tail = FALSE)
    direction <- "overdispersion"
  }
  c(chisq = chisq, ratio = ratio, rdf = rdf, p = p, direction = direction)
}

dog_6month_human_areas_poisson <- glmmTMB(visit_count ~ sixmonth_spi * (Livestock_Present + Waterhole_Y_N + hot_day_prop) + season + (1|settlement_name) + (1|pack) + ou(period_x_fc+0|id_simple), data = data_dog_count, family = truncated_poisson)

overdisp_fun(dog_6month_human_areas_poisson)
#Poisson appropriate

lion_6month_human_areas_poisson <- glmmTMB(visit_count ~ sixmonth_spi * (Waterhole_Y_N + hot_day_prop) + season + sex + (1|settlement_name) + (1|pack/id_simple) + ou(period_x_fc+0|id_simple), data=data_lion_count, family = truncated_poisson)

overdisp_fun(lion_6month_human_areas_poisson)
#Poisson appropriate

leopard_6month_human_areas_poisson <- glmmTMB(visit_count ~ sixmonth_spi * (Waterhole_Y_N + hot_day_prop) + season + (1|settlement_name) + (1|id_simple) + ou(period_x_fc+0|id_simple), data=data_leopard_count, family = truncated_poisson)

overdisp_fun(leopard_6month_human_areas_poisson)
#Overdispersed

cheetah_6month_human_areas_poisson <- glmmTMB(visit_count ~ sixmonth_spi * (Waterhole_Y_N + hot_day_prop) + season + sex + (1|settlement_name) + (1|id_simple) + ou(period_x_fc+0|id_simple), data=data_cheetah_count, family = truncated_poisson)
summary(cheetah_6month_human_areas_poisson)
#No convergence

```

## Bootstrap CIs on GPS model cofficients 

```{r}

bootstrap_CI_gps <- function(model, nb = 1000, seed = 1) {
  
  set.seed(seed)
  
  mf     <- model.frame(model)
  n      <- nrow(mf)
  ncoef  <- length(fixef(model)$cond)
  coefmat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = ncoef, ncol = nb)
  
  start_time <- Sys.time()
  failures <- 0
  i <- 1
  
  while (i <= nb) {
    tryCatch({
      
      ynew <- simulate(model)[[1]]
      
      newdat <- mf
      resp_name <- all.vars(formula(model))[1]
      newdat[[resp_name]] <- ynew
      
      bmod <- update(model, data = newdat)
      
      coefmat[, i] <- fixef(bmod)$cond[names(fixef(model)$cond)]
      
      if (i %% 100 == 0) {
        elapsed <- difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "mins")
        rate <- as.numeric(elapsed) / i
        remaining <- rate * (nb - i)
        cat(sprintf("Iteration %d/%d | Elapsed: %.1f min | Est. remaining: %.1f min | Failures skipped: %d\n",
                    i, nb, as.numeric(elapsed), remaining, failures))
      }
      
      i <- i + 1
      
    },
    warning = function(w) {},
    error   = function(e) { failures <<- failures + 1 })
  }
  
  cat(sprintf("\nDone! Total time: %.1f min | Total failures skipped: %d\n",
              as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "mins")), failures))
  
  rownames(coefmat) <- names(fixef(model)$cond)
  
  CIs <- t(apply(coefmat, 1, function(x) quantile(x, c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)))
  colnames(CIs) <- c("2.5%", "97.5%")
  
  CIs
}


# Bootstrap CIs for truncated NB models
CIs_dog_6month_poisson     <- bootstrap_CI_gps(dog_visits)
CIs_lion_6month_poisson    <- bootstrap_CI_gps(lion_visits)
CIs_leopard_6month_negbinom <- bootstrap_CI_gps(leopard_visits)

tidy_CI <- function(CI_matrix, species, model_name) {
  as.data.frame(CI_matrix) %>%
    mutate(coefficient = rownames(CI_matrix)) %>%
    dplyr::select(coefficient, `2.5%`, `97.5%`) %>%
    mutate(
      species = species,
      model   = model_name
    )
}

all_CIs_gps_coefs <- bind_rows(
  tidy_CI(CIs_dog_6month_poisson,     "African Wild Dog", "6-month"),
  tidy_CI(CIs_lion_6month_poisson,    "Lion",             "6-month"),
  tidy_CI(CIs_leopard_6month_negbinom, "Leopard",          "6-month")
) %>%
  dplyr::select(species, model, coefficient, `2.5%`, `97.5%`)


saveRDS(all_CIs_gps_coefs, "all_CIs_gps_coefs")
#all_CIs_gps_coefs <- readRDS("all_CIs_gps_coefs")


```


## Models for supplementary

## Adding step length into model dataframe

```{r}

add_step_length <- function(all_locations, count_data, species_name) {

  steps <- all_locations %>%
    filter(species == species_name)

  step_monthly <- steps %>%
    group_by(id_simple, YearMon) %>%
    summarise(
      median_step = median(dist, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_step   = mean(dist,   na.rm = TRUE),
      n_steps     = sum(!is.na(dist)),
      .groups     = "drop"
    )

  count_data %>%
    left_join(step_monthly, by = c("id_simple", "YearMon")) %>%
    mutate(
      median_step_s = as.numeric(scale(median_step)),
      mean_step_s   = as.numeric(scale(mean_step))
    )
}

data_dog_count_step <- add_step_length(
  all_locations,
  data_dog_count,
  "African Wild Dog"
)

data_lion_count_step <- add_step_length(
  all_locations,
  data_lion_count,
  "Lion"
)

data_leopard_count_step <- add_step_length(
  all_locations,
  data_leopard_count,
  "Leopard"
)

data_cheetah_count_step <- add_step_length(
  all_locations,
  data_cheetah_count,
  "Cheetah"
)


```

## PAC Models

```{r test for under and overdispersion}

overdisp_fun <- function(model) {
  rdf <- df.residual(model)
  rp <- residuals(model, type = "pearson")
  chisq <- sum(rp^2)
  ratio <- chisq/rdf
  # Two-sided: test whichever tail the ratio falls in
  if (ratio < 1) {
    p <- pchisq(chisq, df = rdf, lower.tail = TRUE)
    direction <- "underdispersion"
  } else {
    p <- pchisq(chisq, df = rdf, lower.tail = FALSE)
    direction <- "overdispersion"
  }
  c(chisq = chisq, ratio = ratio, rdf = rdf, p = p, direction = direction)
}

conflict_model_poisson <- glmmTMB(conflict_count ~ spi_sixmonth * ConflictSpecies + hot_day_prop * ConflictSpecies + spi_sixmonth * hot_day_prop + season + (1 | station) + (1|YearMon) + ou(period_x_fc + 0|station_species), family = poisson(link = "log"), data = pac_data_ngami)
summary(conflict_model_poisson)

overdisp_fun(conflict_model_poisson)
#Model is underdispersed, use genpois distribution


```


```{r deciding on zero inflation term}

m_monthly_genpois <- glmmTMB(conflict_count ~ spi_sixmonth * ConflictSpecies + hot_day_prop * ConflictSpecies + spi_sixmonth * hot_day_prop + season + (1 | station) + (1|YearMon) + ou(period_x_fc + 0|station_species), ziformula = ~ 1, family = genpois(link = "log"), data = pac_data_ngami)
summary(m_monthly_genpois)

m_monthly_genpois_noZ <- glmmTMB(conflict_count ~ spi_sixmonth * ConflictSpecies + hot_day_prop * ConflictSpecies + spi_sixmonth * hot_day_prop + season + (1 | station) + (1|YearMon) + ou(period_x_fc + 0|station_species), family = genpois(link = "log"), data = pac_data_ngami)
summary(m_monthly_genpois_noZ)


# --- Zero-inflation model selection ---

# AIC comparison
AIC(m_monthly_genpois, m_monthly_genpois_noZ)
# m_monthly_genpois     23 8496.502  (with ZI)
# m_monthly_genpois_noZ 22 8568.128  (without ZI)
# ZI model is 72 AIC units better

# ZI probability: what proportion of zeros are structural?
plogis(fixef(m_monthly_genpois)$zi)  # 7.3% structural zeros

# Coefficient stability: estimates are nearly identical across models, indicating ZI term does not distort inference on fixed effects

# DHARMa diagnostics
sim_zi <- simulateResiduals(m_monthly_genpois, n = 1000)
sim_nozi <- simulateResiduals(m_monthly_genpois_noZ, n = 1000)
plot(sim_zi)    # passes dispersion and outlier, fails KS test (p=0.005) 
plot(sim_nozi)  # residuals look good

testZeroInflation(m_monthly_genpois)
#ratioObsSim = 1.0402, p-value = 0.736 

testZeroInflation(m_monthly_genpois_noZ)
#ratioObsSim = 1.0462, p-value = 0.768

# Retain ZI term?
# - AIC favours ZI (ΔAIC = 72) (but AIC can prefer more complex models that don't necessarily improve diagnostics)
# - The no-ZI model (image 2) passes all three DHARMa tests, has clean residuals, and both models handle zeros equally well (testZeroInflation both n.s.). 
# - The ZI probability is small (7.3%)
# - Coefficients are nearly identical between models
# - Verdict: Clean diagnostics and stable inference for no-ZI model outweigh the AIC difference, so do not include a zero inflation term in the model.

```

## Bootstrap CIs


```{r}

# ---------------------------
# Bootstrap CI function
# ---------------------------
bootstrap_CI_pac <- function(model, nb = 1000, seed = 42) {
  set.seed(seed)
  
  # Original model frame, to keep rows aligned
  mf     <- model.frame(model)          # includes response + predictors
  n      <- nrow(mf)
  ncoef  <- length(fixef(model)$cond)   # number of conditional fixed effects
  coefmat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = ncoef, ncol = nb)
  
  i <- 1
  while (i <= nb) {
    tryCatch({
      # 1) Simulate new response (same length/order as original)
      ynew <- simulate(model)[[1]]      # returns a vector of length n
      
      # 2) Build new data with simulated response in same column as original
      newdat <- mf
      resp_name <- all.vars(formula(model))[1]  # "conflict_count"
      newdat[[resp_name]] <- ynew
      
      # 3) Refit model with same formula/family but new data
      bmod <- update(model, data = newdat)
      
      # 4) Store conditional fixed-effect estimates
      coefmat[, i] <- fixef(bmod)$cond
      i <- i + 1
    },
    warning = function(w) {},   # silently skip failed fits
    error   = function(e) {})
  }
  
  rownames(coefmat) <- names(fixef(model)$cond)
  
  # 5) 95% percentile CIs
  CIs <- t(apply(coefmat, 1, function(x)
    quantile(x, c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)))
  colnames(CIs) <- c("2.5%", "97.5%")
  CIs
}

# Run bootstrap (start with smaller nb to check speed)
CIs_conflict_coefs <- bootstrap_CI_pac(conflict_model, nb = 1000, seed = 42)

tidy_CI <- function(CI_matrix, model_name) {
  as.data.frame(CI_matrix) %>%
    mutate(coefficient = rownames(CI_matrix),
           model       = model_name) %>%
    dplyr::select(model, coefficient, `2.5%`, `97.5%`)
}

CIs_conflict_coefs <- tidy_CI(CIs_conflict_coefs,
                               model_name = "Monthly NB (6‑month SPI)")

CIs_conflict_coefs

saveRDS(CIs_conflict_coefs, "CIs_conflict_coefs")
#CIs_conflict_coefs <- readRDS("CIs_conflict_coefs")
```

## Figures

```{r plot theme}

# Minimal Tufte-inspired theme
tufte_theme <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Gill Sans", base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      # Remove all non-essential elements
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      
      # Subtle axis lines only where needed
      axis.line.x = element_line(color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.line.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      
      # Larger, clearer text
      axis.title.x = element_text(color = "gray20", size = 15),
      axis.title.y = element_text(color = "gray20", size = 15),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(color = "gray20", size = 12),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(color = "gray20", size = 12),
      
      # Minimal legend with larger text
      legend.background = element_blank(),
      legend.key = element_blank(),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "plain"),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 12),
      
      # Clean strips for facets
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "italic", size = 13, hjust = 0),
      
      # Generous margins
      plot.margin = margin(12, 18, 12, 12),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "plain", hjust = 0),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "gray40", hjust = 0)
    )
}
```

```{r diel period plot for SI}
# Figure S2: Proportion of settlement visits by hour

# Load individual settlement visit records
results_settlement_visits <- readRDS("results_settlement_visits")

# Match animal IDs to species using existing GPS data
all_locations_summary <- all_locations %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  distinct(id, species)

# Calculate the proportion of visits beginning in each hour
hourly_proportion <- results_settlement_visits$detailed %>%
  mutate(
    entry_time = lubridate::force_tz(
      entry_time, tzone = "Africa/Gaborone"
    ),
    entry_hour = lubridate::hour(entry_time)
  ) %>%
  left_join(all_locations_summary, by = "id") %>%
  group_by(entry_hour, species) %>%
  summarise(visit_count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  mutate(proportion = visit_count / sum(visit_count)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Create Figure S2
visits_across_day <- ggplot(
  hourly_proportion,
  aes(x = entry_hour, fill = species, y = proportion)

    position = "dodge",

  labs(
    x = "Hour of Settlement Entry",
```

```{r wild dog spi x waterhole}
# ============================================================================

# Create prediction grid matching your original
spi_vals_boot <- seq(-2, max(data_dog_count$sixmonth_spi, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = 100)

pred_waterhole_boot_grid <- expand.grid(
  sixmonth_spi = spi_vals_boot,
  Waterhole_Y_N = c("N", "Y"),
  Livestock_Present = "N",
  hot_day_prop = mean(data_dog_count$hot_day_prop, na.rm = TRUE),
  season = "Dry",
  settlement_name = unique(data_dog_count$settlement_name)[1],
  pack = unique(data_dog_count$pack)[1],
  id_simple = unique(data_dog_count$id_simple)[1],
  period_x_fc = unique(data_dog_count$period_x_fc)[1]
)

# Bootstrap predictions
set.seed(42)
B <- 1000
n_pred_waterhole <- nrow(pred_waterhole_boot_grid)
pred_mat_waterhole <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_pred_waterhole, ncol = B)

for (b in 1:B) {
  if (b %% 100 == 0) cat("Waterhole iteration", b, "\n")
  
  y_sim <- simulate(dog_visits, nsim = 1)[[1]]
  boot_fit <- update(
    dog_visits,
    visit_count ~ .,
    data = transform(data_dog_count, visit_count = y_sim)
  )
  pred_mat_waterhole[, b] <- predict(
    boot_fit,
    newdata = pred_waterhole_boot_grid,
    type = "response",
    re.form = NA
  )
}

# Summarize
waterhole_mean <- apply(pred_mat_waterhole, 1, mean)
waterhole_ci <- t(apply(pred_mat_waterhole, 1, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.975)))

pred_waterhole_boot <- pred_waterhole_boot_grid %>%
  mutate(
    predicted = waterhole_mean,
    lower = pmax(0, waterhole_ci[, 1]),
    upper = waterhole_ci[, 2]
  )

saveRDS(pred_waterhole_boot, "pred_spi_waterhole_boot_newtemp")

) +
```

```{r wild dog spi x heat 40 vs 80}

## -------------------------
## Compute percentiles on non-zero hot days (40th vs 80th)
## -------------------------
non_zero <- data_dog_count %>% filter(hot_day_prop > 0)

hot40_extended <- quantile(non_zero$hot_day_prop, 0.40, na.rm = TRUE)
hot80_extended <- quantile(non_zero$hot_day_prop, 0.80, na.rm = TRUE)

hot_day_values_4080 <- c(0, hot40_extended, hot80_extended)

## -------------------------
## Prediction grid
## -------------------------
pred_data_hotdays_4080 <- expand.grid(
  sixmonth_spi = seq(
    -2,
    max(data_dog_count$sixmonth_spi, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 50
  ),
  hot_day_prop = hot_day_values_4080,
  Livestock_Present = "N",
  Waterhole_Y_N = "N",
  season = "Dry",
  settlement_name = unique(data_dog_count$settlement_name)[1],
  pack = unique(data_dog_count$pack)[1],
  id_simple = unique(data_dog_count$id_simple)[1],
  period_x_fc = unique(data_dog_count$period_x_fc)[1]
)

## -------------------------
## Bootstrap predictions
## -------------------------
set.seed(42)
B <- 1000
n_pred_4080 <- nrow(pred_data_hotdays_4080)
pred_mat_gps_4080 <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_pred_4080, ncol = B)

start_time <- Sys.time()

for (b in 1:B) {
  if (b %% 100 == 0) {
    elapsed <- difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "mins")
    rate <- as.numeric(elapsed) / b
    remaining <- rate * (B - b)
    cat(sprintf("Hot days 40/80 iteration %d/%d | Elapsed: %.1f min | Est. remaining: %.1f min\n",
                b, B, as.numeric(elapsed), remaining))
  }
  
  y_sim <- simulate(dog_visits, nsim = 1)[[1]]
  boot_fit <- update(
    dog_visits,
    visit_count ~ .,
    data = transform(data_dog_count, visit_count = y_sim)
  )
  pred_mat_gps_4080[, b] <- predict(
    boot_fit,
    newdata = pred_data_hotdays_4080,
    type = "response",
    re.form = NA
  )
}

cat(sprintf("\nDone! Total time: %.1f min\n", as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "mins"))))

## -------------------------
## Summarize bootstrap predictions
## -------------------------
gps_mean_4080 <- apply(pred_mat_gps_4080, 1, mean)
gps_ci_4080   <- t(apply(pred_mat_gps_4080, 1, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.975)))

pred_data_hotdays_4080 <- pred_data_hotdays_4080 %>%
  mutate(
    predicted = gps_mean_4080,
    lower     = pmax(0, gps_ci_4080[, 1]),
    upper     = gps_ci_4080[, 2],
    hot_day_prop_f = factor(
      hot_day_prop,
      levels = hot_day_values_4080,
      labels = c("No hot days", "40th percentile", "80th percentile")
    )
  )

saveRDS(pred_data_hotdays_4080, "pred_data_spi_hotdays_4080")

## -------------------------
## Raw data rug (consistent with percentiles)
## -------------------------
data_dog_count_rug_4080 <- data_dog_count %>%
  mutate(
    hot_day_prop_f = case_when(
      hot_day_prop == 0 ~ "No hot days",
      hot_day_prop > 0 & hot_day_prop <= hot40_extended ~ "40th percentile",
      hot_day_prop > hot40_extended & hot_day_prop <= hot80_extended ~ "80th percentile",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    hot_day_prop_f = factor(
      hot_day_prop_f,
      levels = c("No hot days", "40th percentile", "80th percentile")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(hot_day_prop_f))

## -------------------------
## Color palette
## -------------------------
spi_heat_palette_4080 <- viridisLite::plasma(n = 3, begin = 0.15, end = 0.75)
names(spi_heat_palette_4080) <- c("No hot days", "40th percentile", "80th percentile")

## -------------------------
## Plot function
## -------------------------
make_dog_spi_heat_plot_bootstrap <- function(
  pred_data,
  raw_data_rug,
  title_suffix,
  livestock = "N",
  palette
) {
  ggplot(
    pred_data,
    aes(
      x = sixmonth_spi,
      y = predicted,
      color = hot_day_prop_f,
      fill = hot_day_prop_f
    )
  ) +
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
      alpha = 0.2,
      color = NA
    ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.6) +
    geom_rug(
      data = raw_data_rug,
      aes(x = sixmonth_spi, color = hot_day_prop_f),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      sides = "b",
      alpha = 0.6
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "gray50",
      linewidth = 0.6
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = palette, name = "Hot days") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette, guide = "none") +
    labs(
      # title = paste(
      #   "Drought × Heat interaction (Wild dogs)",
      #   "| Livestock:", ifelse(livestock == "Y", "Present", "Absent"),
      #   "|", title_suffix
      # ),
      x = "Standard Precipitation Index\n(← Drought | Wet →)",
      y = "Predicted visits"
    ) +
    tufte_theme()
}

## -------------------------
## Generate plot
## -------------------------
fig_dog_04080_boot <- make_dog_spi_heat_plot_bootstrap(
  pred_data = pred_data_hotdays_4080,
  raw_data_rug = data_dog_count_rug_4080,
  livestock = "N",
  palette = spi_heat_palette_4080
) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = spi_heat_palette_4080,
    name = "Extreme Heat Days",
    labels = c("No hot days" = "No extreme heat days",
               "40th percentile" = "40th percentile",
               "80th percentile" = "80th percentile")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = spi_heat_palette_4080, guide = "none")

fig_dog_04080_boot
```

```{r descriptive figures}
# Damage types

# ============================================================
# Data prep
# ============================================================

damage_summary <- read_csv("damage_summary.csv")

# Totals for left panel
total_all <- sum(damage_summary$total_conflicts)

damage_totals <- damage_summary %>%
  group_by(Damage_list) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(total_conflicts)) %>%
  mutate(
    prop_of_total = total / total_all,
    label = scales::percent(prop_of_total, accuracy = 0.1),
    Damage_list = reorder(Damage_list, -total)
  )

damage_order <- levels(damage_totals$Damage_list)

# Props for right panel
damage_props <- damage_summary %>%

# ============================================================

# ============================================================
# Right panel: proportional fill, no labels

  )

# ============================================================
# Combine
```

```{r PAC main drought effect}

## -------------------------
## 1. Define species + prediction grid
## -------------------------

all_species <- c("African Wild Dog", "Cheetah", "Hyena", "Leopard", "Lion")

pred_spi_all_boot <- expand.grid(
  spi_sixmonth = seq(
    min(pac_data_ngami$spi_sixmonth, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(pac_data_ngami$spi_sixmonth, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 100
  ),
  hot_day_prop = 0,  # main drought effect
  ConflictSpecies = all_species,
  season = "Dry",
  station = unique(pac_data_ngami$station)[1],
  YearMon = unique(pac_data_ngami$YearMon)[1],
  period_x_fc = unique(pac_data_ngami$period_x_fc)[1],
  station_species = unique(pac_data_ngami$station_species)[1]
)

## -------------------------
## 2. Bootstrap predictions
## -------------------------

set.seed(42)
B <- 1000
n_pred <- nrow(pred_spi_all_boot)
pred_mat <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_pred, ncol = B)

for (b in 1:B) {

  if (b %% 100 == 0) cat("Bootstrap iteration:", b, "\n")

  tryCatch({

    # Simulate new response
    y_sim <- simulate(conflict_model, nsim = 1)[[1]]

    # Refit model
    boot_fit <- update(
      conflict_model,
      conflict_count ~ .,
      data = transform(pac_data_ngami, conflict_count = y_sim)
    )

    # Population-level prediction
    pred_mat[, b] <- predict(
      boot_fit,
      newdata = pred_spi_all_boot,
      type = "response",
      re.form = NA
    )

  }, error = function(e){})
}

## -------------------------
## 3. Summarise bootstrap distribution
## -------------------------

pred_spi_all_boot <- pred_spi_all_boot %>%
  mutate(
    predicted = apply(pred_mat, 1, mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    lower     = apply(pred_mat, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    upper     = apply(pred_mat, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    lower     = pmax(0, lower)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ConflictSpecies = factor(
      ConflictSpecies,
      levels = c("Lion", "African Wild Dog", "Leopard", "Hyena", "Cheetah")
    )
  )

saveRDS(pred_spi_all_boot, "pred_spi_all_boot_newtemp")
#pred_spi_all_boot <- readRDS("pred_spi_all_boot_newtemp_final")

## -------------------------
## 4. Raw data for rug
## -------------------------

raw_rug_boot <- pac_data_ngami %>%
  mutate(
    ConflictSpecies = factor(
      ConflictSpecies,
      levels = c("Lion", "African Wild Dog", "Leopard", "Hyena", "Cheetah")
    )
  )


fig_spi_facets_boot <- ggplot(
  pred_spi_all_boot,
  aes(x = spi_sixmonth, y = predicted)
) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = ConflictSpecies),
    alpha = 0.2,
    color = NA
  ) +
  geom_line(
    aes(color = ConflictSpecies),
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  geom_rug(
    data = raw_rug_boot,
    aes(x = spi_sixmonth, color = ConflictSpecies),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    sides = "b",
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray50",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = species_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = species_colors) +
  facet_wrap(~ ConflictSpecies, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "Standard Precipitation Index\n(← Drought | Wet →)",
    y = "Predicted conflict count"
  ) +
  tufte_theme() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold")
  )
```

```{r predicted visits in low vs high SPI}

# Convert YearMon to Date if needed
human_area_visits_monthly <- human_area_visits_monthly %>%
  mutate(YearMon_date = as.Date(paste0(YearMon, "-01")))

pac_data_ngami <- pac_data_ngami %>%
  mutate(YearMon_date = as.Date(paste0(YearMon, "-01")))

start_date <- min(human_area_visits_monthly$YearMon_date, na.rm = TRUE)
end_date   <- max(pac_data_ngami$YearMon_date, na.rm = TRUE)

#SPI data
spi_dogcamp <- read_csv("spi_rainfall_dog_camp.csv")

spi_subset <- spi_dogcamp %>%
  filter(date >= start_date & date <= end_date)

spi_summary <- spi_subset %>%
  summarise(
    spi_min = min(spi.6, na.rm = TRUE),
    spi_max = max(spi.6, na.rm = TRUE),
    spi_25  = quantile(spi.6, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    spi_75  = quantile(spi.6, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    spi_20  = quantile(spi.6, 0.20, na.rm = TRUE),
    spi_80  = quantile(spi.6, 0.80, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# --- Exact percentiles from observed data ------------------------------------

# Extract numeric values from spi_summary
spi_min <- spi_summary$spi_min
spi_max <- spi_summary$spi_max
spi_20  <- spi_summary$spi_20
spi_25  <- spi_summary$spi_25
spi_75  <- spi_summary$spi_75
spi_80  <- spi_summary$spi_80

# Helper function (unchanged)
find_closest <- function(target, grid) {
  grid[which.min(abs(grid - target))]
}

# Find closest values on prediction grid
spi_min_closest <- find_closest(spi_min, pred_spi_all_boot$spi_sixmonth)
spi_max_closest <- find_closest(spi_max, pred_spi_all_boot$spi_sixmonth)
spi_20_closest  <- find_closest(spi_20,  pred_spi_all_boot$spi_sixmonth)
spi_25_closest  <- find_closest(spi_25,  pred_spi_all_boot$spi_sixmonth)
spi_75_closest  <- find_closest(spi_75,  pred_spi_all_boot$spi_sixmonth)
spi_80_closest  <- find_closest(spi_80,  pred_spi_all_boot$spi_sixmonth)



# --- 25th / 75th percentile comparison --------------------------------------

pct_change_25_75 <- pred_spi_all_boot %>%
  mutate(dist_25 = abs(spi_sixmonth - spi_25),
         dist_75 = abs(spi_sixmonth - spi_75)) %>%
  group_by(ConflictSpecies) %>%
  summarise(
    pred_drought = predicted[which.min(dist_25)],
    pred_wet     = predicted[which.min(dist_75)],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pct_change = ((pred_drought - pred_wet) / pred_wet) * 100,
    comparison = "25th vs 75th"
  )

# --- 20th / 80th percentile comparison --------------------------------------

pct_change_20_80 <- pred_spi_all_boot %>%
  mutate(dist_20 = abs(spi_sixmonth - spi_20),
         dist_80 = abs(spi_sixmonth - spi_80)) %>%
  group_by(ConflictSpecies) %>%
  summarise(
    pred_drought = predicted[which.min(dist_20)],
    pred_wet     = predicted[which.min(dist_80)],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pct_change = ((pred_drought - pred_wet) / pred_wet) * 100,
    comparison = "20th vs 80th"
  )

# --- Combined view ----------------------------------------------------------

bind_rows(pct_change_25_75, pct_change_20_80) %>%
  select(comparison, ConflictSpecies, pred_drought, pred_wet, pct_change) %>%
  arrange(comparison, ConflictSpecies) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# --- Overall mean across species (for the sentence) -------------------------

bind_rows(pct_change_25_75, pct_change_20_80) %>%
  group_by(comparison) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_pct  = mean(pct_change),
    min_pct   = min(pct_change),
    max_pct   = max(pct_change),
    .groups   = "drop"
  )
```

```{r PAC spi x heat}

## -------------------------
## 1. Compute percentiles on non-zero hot days
## -------------------------
non_zero <- pac_data_ngami %>%
  filter(ConflictSpecies == "Lion" & hot_day_prop > 0)

p40_hot_pac <- quantile(non_zero$hot_day_prop, 0.4, na.rm = TRUE)
p80_hot_pac <- quantile(non_zero$hot_day_prop, 0.8, na.rm = TRUE)

hot_day_values <- c(0, p40_hot_pac, p80_hot_pac)

## -------------------------
## 2. Prediction grid
## -------------------------
pred_interaction_pac <- expand.grid(
  spi_sixmonth    = seq(
    min(pac_data_ngami$spi_sixmonth, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(pac_data_ngami$spi_sixmonth, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 50
  ),
  hot_day_prop    = hot_day_values,
  ConflictSpecies = "Lion",
  season          = "Dry",
  station         = unique(pac_data_ngami$station)[1],
  YearMon         = unique(pac_data_ngami$YearMon)[1],
  period_x_fc     = unique(pac_data_ngami$period_x_fc)[1],
  station_species = unique(pac_data_ngami$station_species)[1]
)

## -------------------------
## 3. Bootstrap predictions
## -------------------------
set.seed(42)
B <- 1000
n_pred <- nrow(pred_interaction_pac)
pred_mat <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_pred, ncol = B)

for (b in 1:B) {
  tryCatch({
    y_sim <- simulate(conflict_model, nsim = 1)[[1]]

    boot_fit <- update(
      conflict_model,
      conflict_count ~ .,
      data = transform(pac_data_ngami, conflict_count = y_sim)
    )

    pred_mat[, b] <- predict(
      boot_fit,
      newdata = pred_interaction_pac,
      type = "response",
      re.form = NA
    )
  }, error = function(e){})
}

## -------------------------
## 4. Summarize bootstrap predictions
## -------------------------
pred_interaction_pac <- pred_interaction_pac %>%
  mutate(
    predicted = apply(pred_mat, 1, mean),
    lower     = apply(pred_mat, 1, quantile, probs = 0.025),
    upper     = apply(pred_mat, 1, quantile, probs = 0.975),
    hot_day_prop_f = factor(
      hot_day_prop,
      levels = hot_day_values,
      labels = c("0", "40th percentile", "80th percentile")
    )
  )

saveRDS(pred_interaction_pac, "pred_spi_interaction_pac_newtemp")
#pred_interaction_pac <- readRDS("pred_spi_interaction_pac_newtemp_final")

## -------------------------
## 5. Raw data rug bins (consistent with percentiles)
## -------------------------
raw_lion_pac <- pac_data_ngami %>%
  filter(ConflictSpecies == "Lion") %>%
  mutate(
    hot_day_prop_f = case_when(
      hot_day_prop == 0 ~ "0",
      hot_day_prop > 0 & hot_day_prop <= p40_hot_pac ~ "40th percentile",
      hot_day_prop > p40_hot_pac & hot_day_prop <= p80_hot_pac ~ "80th percentile",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    hot_day_prop_f = factor(
      hot_day_prop_f,
      levels = c("0", "40th percentile", "80th percentile")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(hot_day_prop_f))

## -------------------------
## 6. Color palette
## -------------------------
spi_heat_palette <- viridisLite::plasma(n = 3, begin = 0.15, end = 0.75)
names(spi_heat_palette) <- c("0", "40th percentile", "80th percentile")

## -------------------------
## 7. Plot function
## -------------------------
make_pac_spi_heat_plot_bootstrap <- function(
  pred_data,
  raw_data_rug,
  title_suffix,
  palette
) {

  ggplot(
    pred_data,
    aes(
      x = spi_sixmonth,
      y = predicted,
      color = hot_day_prop_f,
      fill = hot_day_prop_f
    )
  ) +
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(ymin = pmax(0, lower), ymax = upper),
      alpha = 0.2,
      color = NA
    ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.6) +
    geom_rug(
      data = raw_data_rug,
      aes(x = spi_sixmonth, color = hot_day_prop_f),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      sides = "b",
      alpha = 0.6
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "gray50",
      linewidth = 0.6
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = palette, name = "Hot days") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette, guide = "none") +
    labs(
      #title = paste("Drought × Heat interaction (Reference Species: Lion)", title_suffix),
      x = "Standard Precipitation Index\n(← Drought | Wet →)",
      y = "Predicted conflict count"
    ) +
    tufte_theme() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14)
    )
}

## -------------------------
## 8. Generate plot
## -------------------------

fig_lion_04080_boot <- make_pac_spi_heat_plot_bootstrap(
  pred_data    = pred_interaction_pac,
  raw_data_rug = raw_lion_pac,
  #title_suffix = "0 / 40 / 80 percentiles (Bootstrap 95% CI)",
  palette      = spi_heat_palette
) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = spi_heat_palette,
    name = "Extreme Heat Days",
    labels = c("0" = "No extreme heat days",
               "40th percentile" = "40th percentile",
               "80th percentile" = "80th percentile")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = spi_heat_palette, guide = "none")
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# FIGURE 1: Study System Overview (GPS Collaring Study)
# =============================================================================

# Study site coordinates
study_lat <- -19.523  # 19°31'22.8"S
study_lon <- 23.637   # 23°38'13.0"E
radius_miles <- 50
radius_km <- radius_miles * 1.60934

# Create study site point
study_site <- st_sfc(st_point(c(study_lon, study_lat)), crs = 4326)

# Create circle around study site (30 mile radius)
study_site_proj <- st_transform(study_site, crs = 32734)  # UTM Zone 34S
buffer <- st_buffer(study_site_proj, dist = radius_km * 1000)
buffer_lonlat <- st_transform(buffer, crs = 4326)

# Define bounding box for main map
bbox <- st_bbox(buffer_lonlat)
bbox_expanded <- bbox + c(-0.8, -0.8, 0.8, 0.8)

# Get country boundaries - try high res first, fall back to medium
world <- tryCatch({
  library(rnaturalearthhires)
  cat("Using high-resolution boundaries\n")
  ne_countries(scale = 10, returnclass = "sf")
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("Using medium-resolution boundaries (install rnaturalearthhires for better detail)\n")
  ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")
})

botswana <- world[world$name == "Botswana", ]
africa <- world[world$continent == "Africa", ]

cities <- ne_download(scale = 10, type = "populated_places", 
                      category = "cultural", returnclass = "sf")

# Filter cities near study area
if (!is.na(st_crs(cities))) {
  cities_near <- tryCatch({
    st_filter(cities, bbox_polygon)
  }, error = function(e) {
    st_sf(geometry = st_sfc(crs = 4326))
  })
} else {
  cities_near <- st_sf(geometry = st_sfc(crs = 4326))
}

# ============================================
# DOWNLOAD SATELLITE IMAGERY
# ============================================
cat("Downloading satellite imagery (this may take a moment)...\n")

# Crop features to map extent
bbox_polygon <- st_as_sfc(st_bbox(bbox_expanded), crs = 4326)

# Get satellite imagery for the study area
# Using Esri World Imagery (satellite/aerial imagery)
satellite_tiles <- tryCatch({
  get_tiles(bbox_polygon, provider = "Esri.WorldImagery", zoom = 10, crop = TRUE)
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("Could not download satellite imagery. Using base map instead.\n")
  cat("Error:", e$message, "\n")
  NULL
})

# Panel A: Simplified map - ONLY MAUN labeled
# Calculate 100% MCP for each species using adehabitatHR
species_list <- unique(all_locations$species)
mcp_list <- list()

for (sp in species_list) {
  sp_data <- all_locations %>% 
    filter(species == sp) %>%
    select(x, y, species)
  
  # Convert to SpatialPointsDataFrame
  coordinates(sp_data) <- ~x + y
  proj4string(sp_data) <- CRS("+init=epsg:32734")
  
  # Calculate 100% MCP
  mcp <- mcp(sp_data[, "species"], percent = 100, unout = "km2")
  
  # Convert to sf
  mcp_sf <- st_as_sf(mcp)
  mcp_sf$species <- sp
  mcp_list[[sp]] <- mcp_sf
}

# Combine all MCPs and transform to WGS84
all_mcps <- do.call(rbind, mcp_list) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 4326)

settlements <- read_csv("Settlement_Data.csv")

# Convert settlements to sf and categorize land use
settlements_sf <- st_as_sf(settlements, 
                           coords = c("X_COORDIN", "Y_COORDIN"),

  )

# Identify Dog Camp

# Define tighter bounding box (zoomed in)
bbox_zoom_out <- st_bbox(c(xmin = 22.3, ymin = -20.3, xmax = 24.2, ymax = -18.8), crs = 4326)

# Tighter zoom — cuts empty lower-left, keeps Maun just inside bottom edge
bbox_zoom <- st_bbox(c(xmin = 22.7, ymin = -20.1, xmax = 24.2, ymax = -18.95), crs = 4326)

# Try to reload satellite tiles fresh with zoomed extent
bbox_zoom_polygon <- st_as_sfc(bbox_zoom)
satellite_tiles_fresh <- tryCatch({
  get_tiles(bbox_zoom_polygon, provider = "Esri.WorldImagery", zoom = 11, crop = TRUE)
}, error = function(e) {

})

cities_near <- cities %>%

# Elegant Tufte-inspired colors for settlements

  {if (!is.null(satellite_tiles_fresh)) {

  theme_void() +
  theme(
  legend.position = "bottom",
  legend.direction = "horizontal",
  legend.box = "vertical",        # species row, then water/land row
  legend.box.just = "center",     # center under map
  legend.text  = element_text(size = 6),
  legend.title = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
  legend.key.width  = unit(0.5, "cm"),
  legend.key.height = unit(0.35, "cm"),
  legend.spacing.x  = unit(0.3, "cm"),
  legend.margin     = margin(t = -3, r = 3, b = 2, l = 3)
)



# =============================================================================
# FIGURE 1B: Climate context — temperature + SPI + data range bars
# Three-panel figure sharing a common x-axis, assembled with patchwork
# =============================================================================

# Define government-designated drought periods (water years: Oct-Sep)
drought_periods <- data.frame(
  start = as.Date(c("2012-10-01", "2014-10-01", "2015-10-01", 
                    "2018-10-01", "2022-10-01")),
  end = as.Date(c("2013-09-30", "2015-09-30", "2016-09-30", 
                  "2019-09-30", "2023-09-30")),
  label = c("2012-13", "2014-15", "2015-16", "2018-19", "2022-23")
)

# Panel B: SPI time series - minimal (using 6-month data)
drought_periods$start <- as.Date(drought_periods$start)
drought_periods$end   <- as.Date(drought_periods$end)

# --- 1. Shared x limits ------------------------------------------------------

x_min <- floor_date(min(as.Date(paste0(
  substr(human_area_visits_monthly$YearMon, 1, 7), "-01")),
  na.rm = TRUE), "year")

x_max <- ceiling_date(max(as.Date(paste0(
  substr(pac_data_ngami$YearMon, 1, 7), "-01")),
  na.rm = TRUE), "year") - days(1)

shared_x <- scale_x_date(
  limits      = c(x_min, x_max),
  date_breaks = "3 years",
  date_labels = "%Y",
  expand      = c(0, 0)
)

# --- 2. Data range bars (Panel A) --------------------------------------------

gps_min  <- min(as.Date(paste0(substr(human_area_visits_monthly$YearMon, 1, 7), "-01")), na.rm = TRUE)
gps_max  <- max(as.Date(paste0(substr(human_area_visits_monthly$YearMon, 1, 7), "-01")), na.rm = TRUE)
conf_min <- min(as.Date(paste0(substr(pac_data_ngami$YearMon, 1, 7), "-01")),           na.rm = TRUE)
conf_max <- max(as.Date(paste0(substr(pac_data_ngami$YearMon, 1, 7), "-01")),           na.rm = TRUE)

data_ranges <- data.frame(
  label = c("GPS data", "Conflict data"),
  xmin  = c(gps_min,  conf_min),
  xmax  = c(gps_max,  conf_max),
  y     = c(2, 1)
)

# Neutral elegant palette: dark brown for GPS, navy for conflict
bar_colors <- c("GPS data"      = "#4a2c2a",   # dark brown
                "Conflict data" = "#1b2a4a")    # navy

label_color <- "beige"

fig1_B_bars <- ggplot(data_ranges) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = xmin, xend = xmax, y = y, yend = y, color = label),
               linewidth = 4.5, lineend = "round") +
  # Labels sit above the line, in dark grey (not matching bar colour)
  geom_text(aes(x = xmin, y = y, label = label),
            color    = label_color,
            hjust    = 0,
            nudge_y  = 0,
            size     = 3.5,
            fontface = "bold") +
  scale_color_manual(values = bar_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.3, 2.9), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  shared_x +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  tufte_theme() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid   = element_blank()
  )

# --- 3. Temperature panel (Panel B) ------------------------------------------
# Aggregate hourly → monthly mean, min, max

## Raw temperature data ☑️
temperature_raw <- read_csv("Temperature_Hourly_Era5.csv")

# Calculate daily maximum temperatures ☑️
temperature_daily <- temperature_raw %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(Date)) %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(temperature_max = max(Temperature)) %>%
  mutate(
    month = month(date),
    year = year(date),
    day = yday(date)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

temperature_monthly <- temperature_raw %>%
  mutate(date = floor_date(as.Date(Date), "month")) %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(
    temp_mean = mean(Temperature, na.rm = TRUE),
    temp_max  = max(Temperature,  na.rm = TRUE),
    temp_min  = min(Temperature,  na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups   = "drop"
  )


#Calculate hot day threshold ERA5 data
temperature_daily_baseline <- filter(temperature_daily, year > 1990 & year <2021)
hot_threshold_c <- quantile(temperature_daily_baseline$temperature_max, 0.9, na.rm = TRUE)
#35.69702 

# Create hot_day flag for all dates
hot_daily <- temperature_daily %>%
  mutate(hot_day = ifelse(temperature_max > hot_threshold_c, 1, 0)) %>%
  dplyr::select(date, hot_day)

hot_monthly <- hot_daily %>%
  mutate(YearMon = format(date, "%Y-%m")) %>%
  group_by(YearMon) %>%
  summarise(
    hot_day_count = sum(hot_day, na.rm = TRUE),
    hot_day_prop  = mean(hot_day, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Months with at least one extreme heat day, joined to mean temp for y position
hot_months <- hot_monthly %>%
  filter(hot_day_count > 0) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(paste0(YearMon, "-01"))) %>%
  left_join(temperature_monthly %>% select(date, temp_mean), by = "date")

fig1_B_temp <- ggplot(temperature_monthly, aes(x = date)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = temp_min, ymax = temp_max),
              fill = "#e9c46a", alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_line(aes(y = temp_mean), color = "#e9c46a", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(data  = hot_months,
             aes(x = date, y = temp_mean),
             color = "#e76f51", #"#e63946"
             fill  = "#e76f51",
             shape = 21,
             size  = 1.5,
             alpha = 0.85) +
  shared_x +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Temperature (°C)") +
  tufte_theme() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  )

# --- 4. SPI panel (Panel C) --------------------------------------------------

fig1_B_spi <- ggplot(spi_dogcamp, aes(x = date, y = spi.6)) +
  geom_rect(data = drought_periods,
            aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "#e76f51", alpha = 0.18) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  # dotted -1 line removed
  geom_line(color = "#264653", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-2, 2)) +
  shared_x +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = "Standard Precipitation Index\n(← Drought | Wet →)") +
  tufte_theme()

# --- 5. Assemble with patchwork ----------------------------------------------

fig1_B <- fig1_B_bars / fig1_B_temp / fig1_B_spi +
  plot_layout(heights = c(0.15, 1, 1)) &
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(t = 2, r = 6, b = 2, l = 6)
  )

fig1_B



# Panel E: Monthly precipitation
precip_monthly <- spi_dogcamp %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_precip = mean(rainfall.mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_precip = sd(rainfall.mm, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    month_name = factor(month, levels = 1:12,
                        labels = c("Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun",
                                   "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"))
  )

fig1_E <- ggplot(precip_monthly, aes(x = month, y = mean_precip)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_precip - se_precip, ymax = mean_precip + se_precip),
              fill = "#2a9d8f", alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(color = "#264653", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(color = "#264653", size = 1.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 12, 2),
                     labels = month.abb[seq(1, 12, 2)]) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Precipitation (mm)") +
  tufte_theme()


# district coordinates (approximate centroids - adjust as needed)
district_coords <- data.frame(
  district = c("Ngamiland", "Chobe", "Central", "Gantsi", "Kweneng", 
               "Kgalagadi", "Southern", "Kgatleng"),
  lon = c(22.5, 25.0, 26.5, 22.0, 24.5, 22.5, 25.5, 26.0),
  lat = c(-19.5, -18.0, -21.5, -22.5, -24.0, -25.5, -25.0, -24.5)
)

# Panel A: Map (legend moved below, horizontal)
district_rates <- pac_data_all %>%
  group_by(district) %>%
  summarise(
    total = n(),
    n_months = n_distinct(YearMon),
    rate = n() / n_distinct(YearMon),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(district_coords, by = "district") %>%
  arrange(desc(rate))  # Order by rate, not total

# ==============================================================================
# PART 1: CREATE PAC STATIONS DATA
# ==============================================================================

# PAC reporting stations in Ngamiland
pac_stations <- tribble(
  ~station,    ~lat,        ~lon,
  "Gumare",    -19.355682,  22.155008,
  "Maun",      -19.995434,  23.417970,
  "Sehithwa",  -20.473419,  22.700249,
  "Seronga",   -18.819927,  22.419876,
  "Shakawe",   -18.367861,  21.839178
) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)


# ==============================================================================
# PART 2: GET BOTSWANA BOUNDARY
# ==============================================================================

# Country boundary
botswana_country <- ne_countries(
  country = "Botswana",
  returnclass = "sf",
  scale = "medium"
)


# Level 1 admin units (districts)
botswana_districts <- gadm(
  country = "BWA",
  level = 1,
  path = tempdir()
) |> st_as_sf()

ngamiland <- botswana_districts %>%
  filter(NAME_1 == "North-West")

# ==============================================================================
# PART 3: GET SATELLITE IMAGERY FOR BOTSWANA
# ==============================================================================

# Create bounding box for Botswana
botswana_bbox <- st_bbox(botswana_country)

# Expand bbox slightly to ensure full coverage
botswana_bbox_expanded <- st_bbox(c(
  xmin = as.numeric(botswana_bbox["xmin"]) - 0.5,
  xmax = as.numeric(botswana_bbox["xmax"]) + 0.5,
  ymin = as.numeric(botswana_bbox["ymin"]) - 0.5,
  ymax = as.numeric(botswana_bbox["ymax"]) + 0.5
), crs = st_crs(botswana_country))

# Convert to polygon for get_tiles
botswana_bbox_polygon <- st_as_sfc(botswana_bbox_expanded)

# Get satellite tiles
# Note: Lower zoom (6-8) for country-level view, higher zoom makes file huge
satellite_tiles <- tryCatch({
  get_tiles(botswana_bbox_polygon, 
            provider = "Esri.WorldImagery",  # High-quality satellite
            zoom = 7,  # Adjust 6-8 depending on detail needed
            crop = TRUE,
            cachedir = tempdir())
}, error = function(e) {
  message("Could not download satellite tiles: ", e$message)
  NULL
})

if (!is.null(satellite_tiles)) {
  satellite_tiles <- mask(
    satellite_tiles,
    vect(botswana_country)
  )
}


botswana_map_sat <- ggplot() +
  
  # Satellite imagery
  { if (!is.null(satellite_tiles)) {
    geom_spatraster_rgb(
      data = satellite_tiles,
      maxcell = 1e6,
      alpha = 0.75
    )
  }
  } +
  
  # Botswana outline
  geom_sf(
    data = botswana_country,
    fill = NA,
    color = "gray40",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  
  # Ngamiland outline (more visible)
  geom_sf(
    data = ngamiland,
    fill = NA,
    color = "#2f4f4f",
    linewidth = 0.9,
    linetype = "longdash"
  ) +
  
  # PAC stations (colored individually)
  geom_sf(
    data = pac_stations,
    aes(fill = station),
    shape = 21,
    fill = "gray50",
    color = "white",
    size = 3.8,
    stroke = 1.2
  ) +
  #scale_fill_manual(values = station_colors, guide = "none") +
  
  # Label halo
  geom_sf_text(
    data = pac_stations,
    aes(label = station),
    size = 3.4,
    fontface = "bold",
    hjust = -0.35,
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  
  # Label foreground
  geom_sf_text(
    data = pac_stations,
    aes(label = station),
    size = 3.4,
    fontface = "bold",
    hjust = -0.35,
    color = "white"
  ) +
  
  # Scale bar with labels
  annotation_scale(
    location = "bl",
    width_hint = 0.25,
    text_cex = 0.8,
    text_col = "white",
    line_col = "white",
    unit_category = "metric",
    style = "ticks"
  ) +
  
  # North arrow
  annotation_north_arrow(
    location = "tr",
    which_north = "true",
    height = unit(0.9, "cm"),
    width  = unit(0.9, "cm"),
    style  = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering
  ) +
  
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.margin      = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )

# ==============================================================================
# REFINED GLOBE INSET FOR BOTSWANA (adapted from your code)
# ==============================================================================

# Create bounding box for Botswana region
botswana_bbox <- st_bbox(c(xmin = 19, xmax = 29, 
                           ymin = -27, ymax = -17),
                         crs = st_crs(4326))

# Get world data
world_sf <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

# Orthographic projection centered on Botswana
ortho_proj <- "+proj=ortho +lat_0=-22 +lon_0=24"

# Transform world data and Botswana box to orthographic projection
world_ortho <- st_transform(world_sf, crs = ortho_proj)
box <- st_as_sfc(botswana_bbox)
box_ortho <- st_transform(box, crs = ortho_proj)


# OPTION B: High-contrast, sophisticated globe
globe_inset_contrast <- ggplot() +
  # Ocean - deeper, more saturated
  geom_circle(aes(x0 = 0, y0 = 0, r = 6.37e6), 
              fill = "#d4e8ee",        # Richer blue
              color = "gray40",
              linewidth = 0.4) + 
  
  # Continents - charcoal
  geom_sf(data = world_ortho, 
          fill = "#4a4a4a",            # Charcoal gray
          color = "#3a3a3a",
          linewidth = 0.15) +
  
  # Highlight Botswana
  geom_sf(data = box_ortho, 
          fill = NA, 
          color = "#c46a4f",           # Terracotta
          linewidth = 1) +
  
  coord_sf(crs = ortho_proj, clip = "on") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA, color = NA)
  )
```

```{r methods figure}
AABBBBB
AABBBBB
AABBBBB
AABBBBB
CCBBBBB
CCBBBBB
CCDEEEE
CCDEEEE
'

methodsfig <- botswana_with_globe +
  fig1_A +
  fig1_B +
  fig1_E +
  empty_panel +

    tag_levels = 'A',
```
